Class SandboxRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx.SandboxRegistry
@ApplicationScoped public class SandboxRegistry extends Object
Remembers which sandbox currently backs each session, and the agent's own conversation id inside it so the next turn can resume. Sandbox names follow moby-bank-<session>-g<generation>; each move creates the next generation. The records are kept in a SandboxRecordStore (PostgreSQL in the application), so they survive a restart; when a record is missing the adapters still find a session's sandbox again by listing sandboxes.

    • bareName

      static String bareName(String listedName)
      A sandbox's name without the agent prefix sbx --cloud ls adds (claude/name). The bare name is what later commands are given: it is the form that was run against a real host, and it is what a listing is compared with.

    • discover

      Optional<SandboxRegistry.Handle> discover(SbxCli cli, SessionId session, Location location)
      The newest generation of the session's sandbox listed at a location, for finding it again after a restart or when the registry points elsewhere. When the registry already knows a sandbox (at the other location), only a newer generation counts: an older one is a source that an earlier move left behind, and it lacks everything done since (for example after the newer sandbox was deleted).
